name: Booga Booga [🎣FISHING]
desc:
Booga Booga is an open-world survival game with many secrets to uncover. Can you survive the vast environment?

🪓 Gather resources!
⛏ Explore caves!
🔨 Build bases!
⚔ Attack other tribes!

Please report exploiters to our community server located in the social links below.

Based off of Soybeen's BOOGA BOOGA, which he has made uncopylocked and free for anyone to use.
